verdict: NO broad build now; validate a narrow local handoff workflow against existing tools

deployment.base: Existing DAW retained; compare whole local product bases before authorising a shell or adaptation

spine.name: Work
spine.identity: Stable internal ID with separately typed composition and recording references
spine.invariant: Composition, recording and release identities remain distinct

spine.name: AssetRevision
spine.identity: Content hash plus stable asset/revision ID
spine.invariant: Original files immutable; a hash is not proof of complete dependencies, audible fidelity or rights

spine.name: PartyThread
spine.invariant: No inferred identity merge, inbox scraping or unapproved send

spine.name: RightsAgreement
spine.identity: Evidence/document ID tied to work or recording
spine.invariant: Composition and master schemes separate; unknown, disputed, proposed and approved remain different

spine.name: Release
spine.invariant: Prepared, approved, submitted, accepted and available are distinct

spine.name: LedgerEntry
spine.identity: Source statement hash and source row reference
spine.invariant: No silent currency/period aggregation; estimate is not payment

components.execution: Local executable and explicitly approved local backup target
components.ours: Quiescent project manifest and separate restore acceptance record
components.selection_reason: Snapshot/recovery mechanism rather than treating file synchronisation as backup
components.acceptance_test: Restore selected projects to a different authorised directory; verify manifests, referenced assets and independently opened outputs; recovery key stays local

components.ours: Versioned per-deliverable recipe, output staging and approval linkage
components.selection_reason: Reuse a mature inspection/conversion surface without building a new media engine
components.acceptance_test: Pin executable/build configuration; malformed and oversized inputs fail within limits; originals unchanged; sample rate/channels/duration/peaks verified

components.execution: Local Python library on staged copies
components.ours: Canonical field mapping and provenance relationships
components.selection_reason: Fits proposed utility runtime and avoids duplicate metadata authorities
components.acceptance_test: Round-trip supported tag fixtures without altering audio; retain unknown fields; reject malformed files safely; no copyright inference

components.execution: Optional local process, disabled until requested
components.ours: Input/weight/parameter/output manifest and explicit quality review
components.selection_reason: Wrapper reuse rather than another model runner; whole-app and device-specific alternatives remain comparators
components.acceptance_test: Review selected weight terms and hash; measure real RAM/VRAM/time; no upload; compare artefacts and alignment; cancellation cannot create an approved output

components.execution: Optional local inference with qualified platform runtime
components.ours: Audio-to-MIDI job evidence and reviewed note output
components.selection_reason: Bounded transcription rather than a heavier research training stack
components.acceptance_test: Confirm platform/Python support; compare note timing and errors on authorised material; preserve input and model identity; no claim of perfect transcription

components.ours: Approved target recipe and separate derived asset
components.selection_reason: Reuse two-pass workflow rather than implement new loudness DSP
components.acceptance_test: Measure selected target and true-peak behaviour on fixtures; keep original master; do not apply a universal loudness target or equate technical pass with artistic acceptance

components.ours: Source-preserving vendor mappings and reconciliation decisions
components.selection_reason: Embedded analysis substrate; existing domain parsers must be evaluated rather than pretending the schema is the whole royalty engine
components.acceptance_test: Exact decimal/currency/period handling; source-row lineage; duplicate imports idempotent; totals tie to originals or explicit exceptions; external extensions disabled by default

components.ours: Bind imported references to Work/AssetRevision; retain originals and unsupported fields
components.selection_reason: Reuse bindings for the existing DAWproject standard rather than invent another universal project format
components.acceptance_test: Safe archive extraction and XML entity policy; supported fixtures only; identify lost/unsupported state; compare exported renders where feasible; never promise arbitrary native project sound fidelity

product_base_comparison.gate: Signed/notarised packaging, actual platform support, project/provenance extensibility and usability
Actual device support, weight terms, download/storage footprint and observed user task
Evaluation-only source; no copying or deployment without an authorised route
PolyForm Noncommercial terms, statement fixtures and exact-money reconciliation
